'''Gantlo''' was a middle-aged [[Gender/Legends|male]] who settled down in [[The Puddle]] while on the run for a variety of criminal offenses. He worked at [[The Sand Bar]] and took over when the previous owner fled after a deal went bad. He would inform the local black marketeers about goods arriving in the settlement and also acted as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] informer.<ref name="H&S" />
